VDD vdd 0 DC -15.0

RG g gsrc 6.0
VG gsrc 0 PULSE(0 -10.0 100n 1n 1n 500n 1u)
XCUT g 0 d MY_LIB_PMOS_DS PARAMS: VTO=-1.495291 KP=4.86534581 THETA=0.263157 CGS=3.64e-10 CGD=1.2e-11 CDS=1.84e-10 ISbody=8.16509e-14 Nbody=1.0
.TRAN 20p 400n
.PLOT TRAN V(d) I(RL)
.END
